evidence.quote: 9. What the executed model did—and did not do
evidence.range_scope: Whole supplied P1 same existing Pro6af51fe2 scientific return; no new Capital proof audit, source-original recovery or hidden-activity inference.

requires: Bounded purpose-built accessible terrestrial fixture family, initially serviceable connection, simultaneous total resultant force≤1kN and moment≤250Nm INCLUDING deployed module, adapters and tool reactions. Replace fastening/key or pin/bush wear sets in bolted-face and fixed-strut-end joints; qualify replacement while every temporary path has a locally observed cut and nearby retained catch, then recover temporary anchors, tooling and stocks. Bounded calibrated force/gap errors, known contact/stiffness range and explicit independent single-fault escape; not arbitrary legacy retrofit or arbitrary hidden defect certification.
